apps.name: Calendar
apps.description: Calendar with events and reminders, a public web page for Apps Hub accounts, and a Telegram mini-app.

apps.name: Tasks
apps.description: Persistent, one-time and periodic tasks with multiple categories per task and optional Budget rewards/penalties on completion, plus a public web page.

apps.name: Shopping List
apps.description: Shared shopping lists that update live on every device, with warranty tracking and optional Budget category deduction when items are marked bought, plus a public web page.

apps.name: mvmCloud
apps.description: A private folder for every Apps Hub profile, with browser file management and administrator-controlled external folder API access.
